title: clearLpBaseline has no production caller although its comments say the full-close teardown calls it, so lp_baseline rows are never deleted

evidence.note: header: cleanup hook for the exitEngine full-close flow

sibling_sites_checked: Every lp_baseline statement (db.ts:631-656) and caller: upsertLpBaseline (lpBaseline.ts:120, :141), getLpBaseline (:205), deleteLpBaseline (:240, no caller). The resume query filters by trade status (db.ts:612-621), so stale rows are not re-registered.
severity_rationale: S4 hygiene: rows accumulate and the documentation is wrong; no behaviour depends on the deletion today.
recommendation: Call it from the genuine-close teardown or delete it and fix the comments. Phase 29.
